The profile

About Baverstock Crescent

Baverstock Crescent is a residential crescent in Milton's Clarke neighbourhood, a pocket of the town that has filled in steadily as Milton has grown westward and northward along the escarpment side. The street's shape matters: a crescent bends back on itself, so traffic on it is local by design, and addresses along the curve face inward toward neighbours rather than out toward a thoroughfare.

Own on Baverstock Crescent? Typical is $850K.
Value my home

Trade patterns

What the record does show is a street of townhomes: every sale on Baverstock in the window was a townhouse, and the type mix is effectively single-form. Because the street's own aggregates are withheld, pricing here makes most sense in the context of the wider Clarke neighbourhood, where comparable townhomes have been the relevant reference point.

The rental side is more legible than the resale side. With so few sales, the street's market is defined less by a trend line than by the scarcity of opportunities to transact at all.

Comparable homes nearby

The neighbourhood's sold-to-ask read sits just under asking, implying a modest but real negotiation room rather than a market where buyers pay at list. For a street like Baverstock, where resale activity is sparse, the Clarke comparable is the more reliable orientation point: it describes what townhouse stock in this part of Milton is actually doing, even when the street itself offers little to read.

Education and schools

No secondary school appears among the nearby options, so the closest secondary is a longer run. School assignment should be confirmed with the boards directly, as proximity does not determine which school serves a given address.

Common questions

Questions about Baverstock Crescent

What kinds of homes are on Baverstock Crescent?
No detached or semi-detached homes appear in the recent activity. The townhouse is the dominant and effectively the only type here.
Which schools are close to Baverstock Crescent?
Tiger Jeet Singh PS, Robert Baldwin PS, and Our Lady of Fatima Catholic ES sit a minute or so further out. Confirm current school assignment with the boards directly.
What's the rental market like on Baverstock Crescent?
The street's rental presence is small relative to its sales activity.
